newsitem.title: UK: Rexam down amid delayed sell orders.
newsitem.headline: Rexam down amid delayed sell orders.

text.p: Shares in British print and packaging maker Rexam dropped over three percent on Thursday after a major series of delayed sell orders were reported.
Rexam shares touched 353p before paring losses slightly to trade at 355-1/2p by 1028 GMT, down 8-1/2p on the day. Some 9.7 million shares had changed hands. The broader market was firm.
Dealers said they unaware of the specific reason for the trades or the identity of the sellers.
"A line of four million shares went through and more followed," one marketmaker said.
